name: FNAL-E-0545
summary: Fermilab E545 used a deuterium-filled 15-foot bubble chamber to compare neutrino interactions on neutrons and protons, measuring quasi-elastic scattering, neutral currents and hadronic final states.
physics_targets: Neutron-versus-proton charged-current and neutral-current cross sections
detection_principle: Photographs recorded the charged-particle tracks produced in deuterium. Event topology and kinematic reconstruction separated neutron and proton interactions, with the weakly bound target enabling nucleon-level studies subject to deuterium corrections.

status.label: Completed / historical

results.summary: Extracted an axial mass of about 1.05 GeV in the stated dipole-form-factor model, compatible with earlier low-energy measurements.
